answers.description: fluencyscore-multispan-v2: reference-free LLM judge (Gemini 3.5 Flash) prompted to enumerate all distinct error spans per hypothesis (0..N) with major/minor severity following MQM-style conventions, plus an explicit omission field. Phrases are mapped to character spans with a deterministic Unicode-normalizing locator (exact / normalized / bounded-fuzzy tiers) with occurrence disambiguation; overlapping and adjacent same-severity spans are merged; whole-segment spans are restricted to garbled outputs. Empty or unscored hypotheses fall back to our prior single-span system. Covers official 21 LPs + challenge sets on mteval-test26.
answers.name: fluencyscore-multispan-v2
